body:
Follows feature:ee70ab461cef2b9c: once Rust can be held, read, changed, checked and locked down with the same commands as Gleam, move Solace's own crate (`solace-cli/`) into the store, so agents change it only through Solace.

### Scope

- A system setting to turn a language off on a machine even when its toolchain is installed.
- Adopting `solace-cli/` as a Rust project; edits outside Solace then become reviewed work (D-58).

### Not in scope

- Type-accurate refs (rust-analyzer / SCIP), several-crate workspaces, proc-macro crates: `solace-cli/` needs none of them.
- Rust `refs` and test reach: moved to feature:ee70ab461cef2b9c (task:d7aa4d5e523a065c).
title: Rust: adopt Solace's own crate
